class.name: OcgGraphic3dClipplane
class.brief_description: Container for properties describing either a Clipping halfspace (single Clipping Plane), or a chain of Clipping Planes defining logical AND (conjunction) operation. The plane equation is specified in "world" coordinate system.
class.description: ! Container for properties describing either a Clipping halfspace (single Clipping Plane), ! or a chain of Clipping Planes defining logical AND (conjunction) operation. ! The plane equation is specified in "world" coordinate system.

method.name: default
method.description: Default constructor. Initializes clip plane container with the following properties: - Equation (0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0) - IsOn (True), - IsCapping (False), - Material (Graphic3d_NameOfMaterial_DEFAULT), - Texture (NULL), - HatchStyle (Aspect_HS_HORIZONTAL), - IsHatchOn (False)

method.name: from_2
method.description: Copy constructor.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Construct clip plane from the passed geometrical definition. By default the plane is on, capping is turned off.

method.name: SetEquation_1
method.description: Set plane equation by its geometrical definition. The equation is specified in "world" coordinate system.

method.name: IsOn
method.description: Check that the clipping plane is turned on.

method.name: SetOn
method.description: Change state of the clipping plane.

method.name: SetCapping
method.description: Change state of capping surface rendering.

method.name: IsCapping
method.description: Check state of capping surface rendering.

method.name: ToPlane
method.description: Get geometrical definition.

method.name: Clone
method.description: Clone plane. Virtual method to simplify copying procedure if plane class is redefined at application level to add specific fields to it e.g. id, name, etc.

method.name: IsChain
method.description: Return TRUE if this item defines a conjunction (logical AND) between a set of Planes. Graphic3d_ClipPlane item defines either a Clipping halfspace (single Clipping Plane) or a Clipping volume defined by a logical AND (conjunction) operation between a set of Planes defined as a Chain (so that the volume cuts a space only in case if check fails for ALL Planes in the Chain).

method.name: ChainPreviousPlane
method.description: Return the previous plane in a Chain of Planes defining logical AND operation, or NULL if there is no Chain or it is a first element in Chain. When clipping is defined by a Chain of Planes, it cuts a space only in case if check fails for all Planes in Chain.

method.name: ChainNextPlane
method.description: Return the next plane in a Chain of Planes defining logical AND operation, or NULL if there is no chain or it is a last element in chain.

method.name: NbChainNextPlanes
method.description: Return the number of chains in forward direction (including this item, so it is always >= 1). For a head of Chain - returns the length of entire Chain.

method.name: SetChainNextPlane
method.description: Set the next plane in a Chain of Planes. This operation also updates relationship between chains (Previous/Next items), so that the previously set Next plane is cut off.

method.name: CappingColor
method.description: Return color for rendering capping surface.

method.name: SetCappingColor
method.description: Set color for rendering capping surface.

method.name: SetCappingMaterial
method.description: Set material for rendering capping surface.

method.name: CappingMaterial
method.description: Returns capping material.

method.name: SetCappingTexture
method.description: Set texture to be applied on capping surface.

method.name: CappingTexture
method.description: Returns capping texture map.

method.name: SetCappingHatch
method.description: Set hatch style (stipple) and turn hatching on.

method.name: CappingHatch
method.description: Returns hatching style.

method.name: SetCappingCustomHatch
method.description: Set custom hatch style (stipple) and turn hatching on.

method.name: CappingCustomHatch
method.description: Returns hatching style.

method.name: SetCappingHatchOn
method.description: Turn on hatching.

method.name: SetCappingHatchOff
method.description: Turn off hatching.

method.name: IsHatchOn
method.description: Returns True if hatching mask is turned on.

method.name: CappingAspect
method.description: Return capping aspect.

method.name: SetCappingAspect
method.description: Assign capping aspect.

method.name: ToUseObjectMaterial
method.description: Flag indicating whether material for capping plane should be taken from object. Default value: FALSE (use dedicated capping plane material).

method.name: SetUseObjectMaterial
method.description: Set flag for controlling the source of capping plane material.

method.name: ToUseObjectTexture
method.description: Flag indicating whether texture for capping plane should be taken from object. Default value: FALSE.

method.name: SetUseObjectTexture
method.description: Set flag for controlling the source of capping plane texture.

method.name: ToUseObjectShader
method.description: Flag indicating whether shader program for capping plane should be taken from object. Default value: FALSE.

method.name: SetUseObjectShader
method.description: Set flag for controlling the source of capping plane shader program.

method.name: ToUseObjectProperties
method.description: Return true if some fill area aspect properties should be taken from object.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: MCountEquation
method.description: Returns modification counter for equation.

method.name: MCountAspect
method.description: Returns modification counter for aspect.
